data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2023 was $0.461m (gross). Analysis of the gross claims development table indicates a modest prior-year release of approximately $0.196m (gross) predominantly from the 2021 underwriting year. No explicit narrative quantifying a gross prior-year movement was found; the movement is derived from the gross claims development table. The movement appears driven by favourable claims development.
raw_causal_phrases: Inflation assumptions are included within the SIAB's reserving processes to cover all forms of inflation, which will increase future claims payments.
The principal assumption underlying the liability estimates is that the future claims development will follow a similar pattern to past claims development experience.
The following analysis is performed for reasonably possible movements in key assumptions
Five percent increase in claim liabilities

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was not stated as a single gross movement in narrative or a dedicated prior-year movement note. The prior-year movement (-0.196m) was calculated from the gross claims development table (gross triangle) by excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2022 and 2023) and comparing the current estimate to the previous diagonal for 2021. Numbers in the accounts are presented in $'000; amounts above are converted to millions but remain in the native currency (USD). The triangle entries are somewhat non-monotonic; the derived PYD is therefore flagged as calculated (confidence 0.8). No explicit textual sentence quantifying gross prior-year reserve movement was located.
